description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git branch display and management commands, including branch listing, sorting, formatting, and color output within a Git repository testing environment.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks for their successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting failure and verifies the failure occurred.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with expected output files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color codes in output for verification.

methods.name: test_terminal
methods.description: Runs commands with simulated TTY to test color and formatting features.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message.
